asset_heavy.reason: Designs storage hardware and software; manufacturing is outsourced and cloud services run on partner hyperscalers, so it is relatively asset-light.

big_ticket.reason: Enterprise storage arrays and platforms are large, infrequent purchases, though cloud and Keystone subscriptions are smaller.

cyclical_demand.reason: Enterprises can delay storage hardware and infrastructure upgrades in a downturn, though data growth supports demand.

large_customers.reason: Customers named include top global banks, semiconductor leaders, large healthcare providers, governments and enterprises running AI workloads.

notes: Revenue mix between one-time hardware and recurring support and cloud is judged from general knowledge.

offers_products.reason: Sells enterprise storage systems, ONTAP software and data infrastructure platforms.

offers_services.reason: Offers support, professional services, Keystone storage-as-a-service and managed cloud storage services alongside its products.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay mainly for storage hardware, software and cloud technology, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Support contracts, cloud services, subscriptions and Keystone, plus repeat enterprise buyers, make up a large share of revenue.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Enterprise storage and data infrastructure sold to businesses and governments, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to banks, chip designers, healthcare providers, media companies, automakers and government agencies.
